== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Anguish]] that uses the [[Anguish (attack)|Anguish attack skill]].
* Synergizes with [[Painful Bond]].
* Synergizes well with [[Blood Bond]] which grants healing to the spirit while also fulfilling the requirement for a hexed target. 
* On hexed foes, Anguish also doubles the bonus damage from [[Signet of Ghostly Might]] and [[Anthem of Envy]].
* [[Spiritleech Aura]] combines poorly with Anguish, as the [[damage reduction]] penalty significantly reduces the effectiveness of this spirit.

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] is similar to [[Cry of Pain]].
